WING S · yard 22.75 · x 4.18 S · h 12.15
The general arrangement’s words (ferry-ship.js), then the named fittings built in the room (ferry-interior.js).
Design: Wheelhouse: the steering stand (wheel, non-follow-up lever, autopilot); two engine levers and the thruster lever at the centre and on both wing consoles; the radar; the
magnetic compass periscope; VHF with DSC; the ship’s telephone; the NAVTEX printer; the echo sounder; the GPS display; the chart table with its drawers and red lamp; the
navigation-light panel; the fire panel; the PA and general alarm; the ramp lamps; the whistle button; the searchlight control; the wipers; a clock, a barometer, an inclinometer;
the log desk; the master’s high chair
Built: wing door ×2, wheelhouse console, steering stand, chart table
Design: Bridge wing, port, open: a wing console with the engine and thruster levers, the port sidelight at its end
Design: Bridge wing, starboard, open: a wing console, the starboard sidelight at its end, the float-free EPIRB
Design: Compass deck: the standard magnetic compass, the mast with the radar scanner on its platform, the masthead light at 15 m, the all-round lights, the whistle, the VHF and
GPS antennas, the searchlight, the company flag
BRIDGE · wheelhouse, wings and compass deck
Consoles, steering stand, chart table, crew stair well, wing consoles
Drawn from buildFerryModel() as the game builds it: plans are cut by a horizontal plane and sections by a vertical one, and what is cut
is drawn heavy, what lies beyond in outline. The design (general arrangement, ferry-ship.js) is dashed over each plan: a room built away
Issues are found in her data by tools/ferry-audit.mjs and numbered for the whole set: red a clash, amber a check. Their source lines are

WORKING DRAWINGS OF THE GAME MODEL · Johansson World vessel · no flag, class or construction approval · buildFerryModel() as built, cut and drawn with hidden lines removed · issues from tools/ferry-audit.mjs
